facts.metric_cpu_throttling_ratio: Container {container}: CPU throttling in {percent}% of periods over {window}.
facts.metric_cpu_usage_vs_limit: Container {container}: peak CPU use was {percent}% of its limit over {window}.
facts.metric_memory_usage_vs_limit: Container {container}: peak memory use was {percent}% of its limit over {window}.
facts.metric_node_memory_available_ratio: Node {node}: available memory dropped to {percent}% over {window}.
facts.metric_node_cpu_utilization: Node {node}: average CPU load was {percent}% over {window}.
facts.metric_node_disk_available_ratio: Node {node}: {percent}% of the root filesystem was free over {window}.
facts.metric_node_pressure_history: Node {node}: resource pressure flag over {window} is {value} (1 means pressure was seen).
facts.metric_pvc_usage_ratio: Volume of claim {pvc}: up to {percent}% of its space was used over {window}.
facts.metric_hpa_at_max_replicas: Autoscaler {hpa}: the replica count reached the configured maximum during {window} (1 means yes, 0 means no): {value}.
facts.metric_deployment_unavailable_replicas: Deployment {deployment}: up to {value} replicas were unavailable over {window}.
facts.metric_ingress_5xx_ratio: Ingress {ingress}: {percent}% of responses were server errors (5xx) over {window}.
facts.metric_ingress_latency_p95: Ingress {ingress}: 95% of requests finished within {value} s over {window}.

hypotheses.metrics_cpu_limited: Container {container} is slowed down by its CPU limit.
hypotheses.metrics_memory_near_limit: Container {container} runs close to its memory limit.
hypotheses.metrics_restarts_growing: Container {container} has been restarting recently, not only in the past.
hypotheses.metrics_node_pressure: Node {node} was short of resources recently.
hypotheses.metrics_pvc_nearly_full: The volume of claim {pvc} is almost full ({percent}% used).
hypotheses.metrics_hpa_saturated: Autoscaler {hpa} cannot add replicas: it has reached its maximum.
hypotheses.metrics_ingress_degraded: Ingress {ingress} is returning errors or answering slowly.

recommendations.rec_review_cpu_limit: Review the CPU limit of container {container}: raise it or remove it if throttling is not intended.
recommendations.rec_review_memory_limit: Review the memory limit of container {container} against its real peak usage.
recommendations.rec_relieve_node_pressure: Move load off node {node} or add capacity to it.
recommendations.rec_expand_pvc: Free space on the volume of claim {pvc}, or expand the claim if its storage class allows it.
recommendations.rec_review_hpa_max_replicas: Review the maximum replica count of autoscaler {hpa}: raise it if the load is legitimate.
recommendations.rec_review_ingress_backend: Check the backends of ingress {ingress}: their readiness, capacity and application errors.

missing.metrics_unavailable: Metrics could not be used as evidence ({reason}). The report is complete without them.

reasons.forbidden: no access to the monitoring service
reasons.unavailable: monitoring did not respond in time
reasons.family_missing: the required metrics are not collected
reasons.history_short: monitoring has not collected enough history yet
reasons.invalid_ref: object name cannot be used in a query

hints.not_installed: Kubron monitoring is not installed in this cluster. Enable it in the cluster settings to add resource usage to diagnostics; everything else works without it.
hints.forbidden: This session may not reach the monitoring service. A cluster administrator needs to bind the role prometheus-proxy-access to your user or group.
hints.unavailable: Monitoring did not answer in time. Diagnostics are based on Kubernetes data only; try again later.
hints.family_missing: Monitoring is running but does not collect the metrics needed here.
hints.no_series: Monitoring has no data for this object.
hints.history_short: Monitoring has not been running long enough to cover the period.
hints.invalid_ref: The object name cannot be safely used in a monitoring query, so the query was not sent.
